scope: TRY FOREVER heartbeat visible-contact owner wiring only; no P0/phone authority.

findings.finding: The first geometry-aware owner recheck required a keyboard-derived ticket's native focus to remain present after mutation. Structural rebuild can destroy the old Button and clear focus before pre-draw, so that rule would reject the exact rebuild restore it claimed to support.
findings.repair: Captured-owner revalidation now treats empty post-mutation direct keyboard focus as possible rebuild-caused focus loss, while a different non-empty focused heartbeat id or changed selection invalidates the ticket. This preserves viewport ownership without claiming keyboard focus survived.

findings.finding: Existing OperatorOverlayService is the sole Android UI owner and now measures live selected/focused controls against the existing HorizontalScrollView before capture. No neighboring renderer/controller/state store was introduced.
TalkBack accessibility focus is neither queried nor inferred. Selection, direct keyboard focus, visible viewport contact, and TalkBack focus remain separate claims.

Viewport generation/idempotence, captured interaction ownership, bounded scroll math, touch semantics, and no-geometry-only-Christmas-motion doctrine remain separated from evidence/announcement identity.
